title: InvestmentNews explores advisor interest in litigation finance
summary: InvestmentNews reports that litigation finance is becoming more accessible to registered investment advisors through alternative investment platforms such as SEI Access. The article explores how advisors are evaluating litigation finance as a differentiated, non-market-correlated asset class, while noting that broader adoption remains driven by education, due diligence and familiarity with the sector. Learn more.
body_markdown:
InvestmentNews reports that litigation finance is becoming more accessible to registered investment advisors through alternative investment platforms. The article explores how advisors are evaluating litigation finance as a differentiated, non-market-correlated asset class, while noting that broader adoption remains driven by education, due diligence and familiarity with the sector.


Read the full article[here](https://www.investmentnews.com/alternatives/rias-explore-litigation-finance-via-sei-access/266602) .
